releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the new callsign login overlay in init(). control variation: skip login, show start overlay directly (original behavior). v1 variation: show login form, persist name to localStorage, retarget LD context to named pilot. Flag evaluated after ldClient.waitForInitialization(3) so real targeting applies. Both overlays start display:none in markup — no flash on either path. Global autogen metrics guard the release (net_new feature path); feature-specific metrics are monitoring-only.

releaseIntent._instructions: Human approver: edit freely. action: auto (release on deploy) | hold (do not release yet) | manual (a human runs the release). Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
